items.title: Shakib, Litton in Diamond category as Tigers flock to APL draft
items.summary: Bangladesh star all-rounder Shakib Al Hasan and T20I captain Litton Das are among a large contingent of Bangladeshi cricketers who have registered for the upcoming Afghanistan Premier League (APL) draft, scheduled to take place in Dubai on November 3.

items.title: 'Your responsibilities now lie with me': Tamim assures High Performance grooming for 21 winners of Robi Bowler Hunt
items.summary: The 'Robi Bowler Hunt', organised in coordination with the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB), concluded with a grand prize-giving ceremony at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur on Monday.

items.title: Khulna, Chattogram sniff victories in NCL
items.summary: Resuming their second innings on 57 for two, Mymensingh reached 315 for nine at stumps, taking a 135-run lead. Al Amin made 102 off 185 balls for his fifth first-class century, while Abdul Mazid contributed 59.

items.title: Afghanistan achieve their highest ODI team ranking
items.summary: Afghanistan were already above experienced teams like Bangladesh, England and West Indies, and have now also overtaken Sri Lanka to achieve their highest-ever position in the Men's ODI Team Rankings

items.title: Nortje returns as South Africa bolster pace attack for Bangladesh Tests
items.summary: Nortje joins the likes of Kagiso Rabada, Marco Jansen, Dane Paterson, Wiaan Mulder and Corbin Bosch to boost South Africa's pace bowling resources.

items.title: Tony de Zorzi returns to South Africa squad for Bangladesh Tests
items.summary: South Africa also picked Zubayr Hamza and Anrich Nortje after he recovered from a groin injury

items.title: Sammy wary of hosts: Can Tigers roar back in Sylhet?
items.summary: Speaking ahead of the second Test, Sammy acknowledged that Bangladesh, under head coach Phil Simmons, would be determined to respond on home soil. However, the West Indies coach remains confident that his side can maintain its momentum and complete a series victory.

items.title: Sammy: 'Our spinners outbowled the Bangladesh spinners' in the Dhaka Test
items.summary: "The way they've shown maturity and responsibility, it's all progress," Daren Sammy says about the West Indies players' performance in the first Test in Dhaka

items.title: Time to rethink home formula
items.summary: Bangladesh’s eight-wicket defeat to West Indies in the first of the two-Test series in Mirpur on Saturday once again exposed the batters’ inability to handle spin, raising a pertinent question: what should the Tigers’ approach to home conditions be?

items.title: King 81*, Chase five-for guide West Indies to victory on tricky pitch
items.summary: King headlined a quick chase of 170 on the fourth day, negating spin-friendly conditions in Mirpur

items.title: Bangladesh bring in Amite Hasan for Mominul Haque for Sylhet Test
items.summary: Mushfiqur Rahim is still in the squad despite missing the first Test with a finger injury

items.title: Shanto blames Bangladesh spinners' inconsistency for Mirpur Test defeat
items.summary: The Bangladesh captain threw his weight behind Taijul Islam, who has taken just five wickets in his last five Test matches

items.title: Chase hails 'good craftsman' Jomel Warrican
items.summary: The left-arm spinner claimed nine wickets and the Player-of-the-Match award in the first Test in Mirpur

items.title: Chase, Warrican trigger Bangladesh's slide after hosts grab slender lead
items.summary: Bangladesh's overall lead grew to 106 after Chanderpaul (56) and Chase (43*) pushed WI to 245

items.title: Sehwag, Dravid in India squad for Under-19 Asia Cup; Raichandani to lead
